01 / REPAIR SERVICES

Dents & dings

Door dings, dents, and damaged body panels deserve a closer look. We assess the location, size, and finish before recommending the repair.

For a helpful estimate

Send photos of the full panel and a close-up of the dent. Include a side angle so we can see its depth.

02 / REPAIR SERVICES

Bumper repair

Scuffs, scrapes, cracks, and bumper damage can call for different repairs. We inspect the damage and recommend repair, refinishing, or a shop assessment as needed.

For a helpful estimate

Include the whole bumper and a close-up of any cracks, loose sections, or paint damage.

03 / REPAIR SERVICES

Paint & scratches

From paint touch-ups to panel refinishing, we match the vehicle’s color and assess how deep the damage goes. Mobile suitability depends on the repair and working conditions.

For a helpful estimate

Photograph the scratch in daylight, without filters, and include the full affected panel.

04 / REPAIR SERVICES

Collision repair

Larger damage is assessed at our Oakland Park body shop. Speak with our team about the affected panels, vehicle condition, and next steps before arranging a visit.

For a helpful estimate

Let us know if the vehicle can be driven. Ask about pick-up and delivery when discussing your repair.
